[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, TX12, is at Vantages Texas Research Park campus in Bexar County, Texas, near the crossing of Omicron Drive and Theta Drive. Trade press (DataCenterDynamics, tier-4 source, https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/vantage-files-to-build-another-data-center-in-san-antonio-texas/) and the DataCenterMap aggregator directory both give this buildings address as 17420 Omicron Drive, San Antonio, TX. DataCenterDynamics reported Vantage filed plans for this facility describing 96 MW of critical IT load, 432,800 square feet, and a 276.8 million dollar investment, with a timeline running from filing in October 2025 to a targeted completion around August 2027. Because that targeted completion is more than a year in the future from this September 2026 research pass, the 96 MW figure is recorded as planned rather than asserted into critical_it_mw. This registry contains two closely spaced OSM ways both named Vantage TX12, roughly 100 meters apart, likely representing the same building mapped twice or two adjacent structures sharing one address. Full descriptive data is applied to both rows, this row (osm:way/1533349844) is treated as the primary of the pair for reference purposes only, an arbitrary designation. A prior note on this row associated it with Frontier, a Vantage mega-campus announced August 2025. This is corrected here, Vantages own August 2025 press release (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/news/vantage-data-centers-unveils-plans-for-frontier-a-25b-mega-campus-in-texas-to-meet-unprecedented-ai-demand/) states Frontier is a 1,200 acre, 1.4 GW, 25 billion dollar, ten building campus in Shackelford County, Texas, near Albany, roughly 300 miles from San Antonio and Bexar County. Frontier is not the San Antonio area campus this row belongs to, it is a separate, later, and much larger project elsewhere in Texas.
